CHAPTER 4 · ITEM 04 / 10

Demand and supply

Supply determinants供給因素

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Predict supply shifts caused by input prices, production technology, expectations and the number of sellers.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

投入成本下降、技術改善或賣家增加通常令供給增加；成本升令供給減少。若能調整生產或存貨，未來價格預期也影響當期供給。

Lower input costs, improved production technology or more sellers usually increase supply. Higher input costs reduce it. Expectations can alter current supply when production or storage can be shifted over time.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：Cheaper steel reduces the cost of making trucks; truck supply shifts right, lowering equilibrium price and raising quantity if demand is unchanged. 鋼價下降令卡車供給增加。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

A new machine lowers unit production cost. Which shift is expected? 新機器降低成本？

這是複習紀錄；答過一題不代表完全掌握。Saved in this browser.
